name: Instagram

disclosure.zh: 视频以 Reels 发布。含逼真的 AI 生成或修改内容时，在「高级设置」里打开「添加 AI 标签」（Meta 也可能自动标注「AI 信息」）。每条最多 5 个话题标签（说明文字和评论合计）。
disclosure.en: Video posts are shared as Reels. For photorealistic AI-made or edited content, turn on "Add AI label" under Advanced settings (Meta may also add "AI info" itself). At most 5 hashtags per post (caption and comments together).

guide.zh: 在 Instagram 页面左侧点「创建」→「帖子」：应用等待最多 2 分钟，看到「从电脑中选择」就自动放入视频。之后你点两次「下一步」（裁剪、编辑；选 9:16 原比例、选封面），说明文字会自动填入。最后由你点「分享」。
guide.en: In Instagram, click Create -> Post: the app waits up to 2 minutes and adds the video once "Select from computer" shows. Then press Next twice yourself (crop: keep the original 9:16; edit: pick the cover); the caption is typed when its box appears. Press Share yourself.

zh: 是否同时分享到主页网格
en: Also share to the profile grid

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written without a logged-in session, 2026-10): Instagram's web markup changes often; check them on the live page and set status to verified + lastVerified.

There is no direct upload URL on desktop web: the create dialog is opened by the creator (Create -> Post); the fill waits for its file input (timeoutMs 120000) and for the caption box after her two Next clicks.
The Share button has no stable selector (a div with text), so it is not highlighted - and never clicked.
The Content Publishing API (Professional account + reviewed Meta app + public video URL) is the engine's optional instagram-api uploader, not this adapter.
